shared_elements: relief carving on a horizontal stone surface
animal legs rendered with articulated musculature
justification: Both surfaces carry relief carvings that include quadrupeds seen in profile with defined legs, but that is about as far as it goes: A shows an elaborate narrative programme with a horse-drawn chariot, a procession of standing robed human figures with staffs and vessels, rosette borders and stepped crenellations, while B shows only one or two crudely blocked-out animal forms (a recumbent/crawling beast plus a lightly incised second animal) isolated on a plain field. The manner of depiction differs sharply too: A is finely detailed, elegantly proportioned and framed in ordered registers, whereas B is lumpy, schematic and unframed.
